how: One source mutation applied to the working tree, the named gate run against it, then the file restored before the next row (`before` is the shipped source the row was run against, `after` the text that replaced it). All rows ran on lease G28-fn0rg, pair-a (`iPhone 17` / iOS 27 and emulator-5574 / API 35, Metro 8295). Filtered gate names satisfy nothing but their own name. Each row's tree digest is the `trees.android` half the run was keyed to, so a run can be matched to the build it pressed.

mutations.mutation: the row stops honouring `enabled`, and the model stops checking it either, so a disabled action is an ordinary row
mutations.second_hunk: the same row, in DialogModel.performAction: `if (action.disabled) {\n      return\n    }` deleted, so nothing else in the component refuses the press either
redTests: takes no tap on a disabled action, and draws it disabled (alert): expected 'locked:action:locked,locked:presented…' to be ''
takes no tap on a disabled action, and draws it disabled (confirmation): expected '1,1,1' to be '1,0,1'
reports the sheet rows as the component draws them, disabled included: expected 'Locked,Go,Wipe' to be 'Locked~,Go,Wipe'
mutations.note: One mutation, three red lines, each from a different claim: the row's own accessibility state (`~`), the row's own drawn state (`drawn=1,0,1` — the disabled label stops being painted faint), and the press the component is supposed to take. The alert's row is red too because the deleted guard was the last thing standing between a disabled alert button and `onAction`.

mutations.mutation: the same one as the row above: `enabled = !action.disabled` becomes `enabled = true` and the guard leaves `DialogModel.performAction`
redTests: the sheet's disabled row is not enabled — expected false, saw true
a real tap on the disabled row leaves the sheet up — expected 1, saw 0
and reports nothing: the log gained only Back's close — expected …action:ok > presented:false > presented:false, saw …action:ok > presented:false > action:locked-row > presented:false
the real tap on "Copy link": 3 real taps left dialog-log "…action:locked-row > presented:false > action:copy > presented:false" rather than "…presented:false > action:copy > presented:false"
mutations.note: A real finger, not a dump: the press on `Locked share` closed the sheet (the up-count) and reported `action:locked-row` (the log), which is the whole reason the check exists. An earlier run of this mutation (08-55-46Z) went red on the first line and then aborted, because the check read the log text while the sheet's own window owned the dump — fixed in 17eb1958 before this row, and the fix is what let lines 2-4 be seen at all.
